[RFCS.19.5] A writer of either container ([RFCS.19.1]) **must** write the
fields of every message it emits in ascending field-number order: each atom
body, and every message nested in one, a fact body included. It **must** write
a field that is not repeated at most once. It **must** write the elements of a
repeated field in the order the clause defining that field states, and, where
no clause states one, in an order that depends on the writer's input alone.

A writer's bytes for one input are then the same on every conforming platform
([LDET.3.4.1]). Ascending order is a property of the bytes alone, so it can be
checked on one platform's output; the element order of a repeated field no
clause orders cannot.
